title.zh: Agent 常驻之后，怎样放心交付？
title.en: Always on. Ready to hand over?

intro.zh: 这周，AI 开始长期待在工位上。我们把问题往前推一步：它忙了一夜之后，怎样留下别人能接手的工作？
intro.en: AI is staying at its desk. This week, we ask what it should leave behind so someone else can confidently pick up the work.

guide.zh: 先把一件事交接好，再谈一支 Agent 团队。让进展、证据和下一步一起留下。
guide.en: Get one handoff right before building a team of agents. Leave progress, evidence and a next step.

detail.zh: 从常驻产品到持久任务，追问谁负责、谁验收、怎样接着做。
detail.en: From persistent agents to durable tasks: ownership, acceptance and continuity.

headline.zh: 把工作交出去，也要让人接得住
headline.en: Hand it off so someone can take over

standfirst.zh: 常驻解决的是谁继续运行，交付解决的是谁能接受这个结果。
standfirst.en: Persistence keeps work running. A handoff lets someone accept the result.

detail.zh: 让正确发生在流程里，把人的精力留给重要判断。
detail.en: Build correctness into the workflow; save attention for judgment.

headline.zh: 代码越来越多，工程要接得住

standfirst.zh: 当执行越来越便宜，队列、返工和验收会变得越来越显眼。
standfirst.en: As execution gets cheaper, queues, rework and acceptance matter more.

detail.zh: 灵感、改进、解释与自主性，需要不同的验证。
detail.en: Ideas, improvement, explanations and autonomy need different tests.

headline.zh: AI 研究 AI，进步怎样算数？
headline.en: When AI researches AI, what counts as progress?

standfirst.zh: 提出想法、改进方法、解释机制与自主行动，各有不同的验证对象。
standfirst.en: Ideas, methods, explanations and autonomy each need their own evidence.

detail.zh: 画图、路由、真机测试与可继续编辑的产物。
detail.en: Diagrams, routing, mobile testing and work you can keep editing.

detail.zh: 长期信任、研究证据，以及新人怎样学会判断。
detail.en: Long-term trust, research evidence and how beginners learn judgment.

headline.zh: 留下记录之后，还要留下什么？
headline.en: What else should survive beyond the record?

standfirst.zh: 长期信任的一部分，是知道未来退出时能带走什么。
standfirst.en: Long-term trust includes knowing what you can take with you.

description.zh: 手绘图的协作工作区，支持保存、归档、分享和 MCP。把讨论留成可继续编辑的图。
description.en: A collaborative diagram workspace with storage, collections, sharing and MCP. Keep the discussion editable.

check.zh: 试一次节点与连线的导出、导入，看看复杂图能否完整保留。
check.en: Try exporting and importing a complex diagram; inspect nodes and connections.

alt.zh: ExcaliClaw 官网的产品吉祥物插画
alt.en: Product mascot artwork from the ExcaliClaw website

description.zh: 一个本地网关，连接不同 Agent、模型与账号。路由过程可见，比单纯自动切换更有用。
description.en: One local gateway connects agents, models and accounts. Visible routing makes fallback easier to understand.

check.zh: 检查切换时的工具调用、上下文与缓存是否连续。
check.en: Check tool calls, context and cache continuity when a route changes.

alt.zh: magpie 官网展示的模型选择面板
alt.en: The magpie model picker shown on its website

description.zh: 通过可访问性树或截图坐标操作 iOS、Android 模拟器与真机，让 Agent 检查真实操作路径。
description.en: Operate iOS and Android simulators or real devices using accessibility trees or screenshot coordinates.

check.zh: 保留设备、系统版本、步骤和失败画面，别只记录点击成功。
check.en: Retain the device, OS version, steps and failure images—not just successful taps.

alt.zh: mobile-mcp 项目展示的终端与手机屏幕镜像
alt.en: The terminal and phone mirror shown in the mobile-mcp project

description.zh: 作者用常驻电脑制作低多边形模型，并连接 Drive 保存产物。值得借鉴的是留下工程文件。
description.en: An author uses a persistent computer to make low-poly models and saves the output to Drive. Keep the working files.

check.zh: 数量目标不等于完成数量；帖中的零额度体验不作为当前资费承诺。
check.en: A quantity target is not a completed count; the account anecdote is not a pricing promise.

alt.zh: KeJun 分享的 Blender 低多边形模型产物
alt.en: Low-poly Blender output shared by KeJun

description.zh: 这次更新把图像接进决策，新增 box 定位输出。下游程序可以接收位置，而不只是一段描述。
description.en: The update adds image input and box localization. A downstream program can receive a position rather than just prose.

check.zh: 保存的发布说明提醒：找不到目标也可能返回框，因此不能把“有框”当成“找到了”。
check.en: The saved release notes warn that a box may be returned even when the target is absent. A box is not proof of detection.

alt.zh: JEV 发布说明中展示的 box 定位示例
alt.en: The box-localization example in the JEV release notes
